toolbar.menu_empty_body: Connect a projector or TV, then reload.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.empty_body: Songs and passages you add from the library show up here, in service order.
schedule.tip_body: Add songs or verses from the library below. Drag rows to reorder, Delete removes the selected item.

welcome.title: Get ready for the service
welcome.unavailable: Unavailable while the library can't be opened.
welcome.song_body_one: Type or paste lyrics. Slides are built as you type, {count} line each.
welcome.song_body_other: Type or paste lyrics. Slides are built as you type, {count} lines each.
welcome.songs_done_body: Add more any time with New song. Search covers titles and lyrics.
welcome.bible_body: Not bundled for copyright reasons. Bring a Zefania XML file you own.
welcome.bible_done_body: Look up verses in the Bible tab below. Add more translations with Manage Bibles.
welcome.output_body: {screen} is already selected. Slides appear there when you go live.
welcome.output_failed: Screens could not be detected. Use Reload screens in the message above.
welcome.output_missing: No screens detected. Connect a projector or TV, then reload screens.
welcome.output_done_body: Slides appear there when you go live.
welcome.output_disconnected: {screen} was disconnected. Reconnect it, then reload screens.

slides.closed_body: Open output (F5) to put slides on {screen}
slides.ready_body: Select a slide and press Go live (Enter)
slides.heading: SLIDES
slides.jump_hint: Click a slide to jump to it
slides.list_empty: Slides appear here once something is live.
slides.black_hint: press B to show slide {position} again
slides.clear_hint: press C to show it again
slides.pick_item: Pick an item in the schedule
slides.nothing_to_preview_body: Select an item from the schedule, or add one from the library below.

status.found_hint: press Enter to add it to the schedule
status.live_kept: Live keeps showing {title} until you change it
status.rebuilt: items rebuilt with the current theme
status.name_taken: that file name is already taken

unsaved.title: Save changes to “{name}”?
unsaved.on_new: You're starting a new schedule. Unsaved changes to this one will be lost. What is on the projector keeps showing until you change it.
unsaved.on_open: You're opening another schedule. Unsaved changes to this one will be lost. What is on the projector keeps showing until you change it.
unsaved.on_quit: SolideoWorship is closing. Unsaved changes to “{name}” will be lost.

files.pick_bible: Choose a Zefania XML Bible file
files.taken_body: The save dialog can't confirm overwriting. Choose that file directly in the dialog to replace it, or use another name.

library.search: Search songs by title or lyrics
library.song_hint: Click a song to add it to the schedule.
library.truncated: Only the top results are shown. Type more of the title or a lyric line to see other songs.
library.empty_body: Create a song with New song. Search covers titles and lyrics once songs are added.
library.unavailable_body: Songs and Bibles can't be loaded right now. Schedules and the output still work.
library.no_match_body: Check the spelling, or search for a line from the lyrics.
library.search_hint: Results update as you type. Enter adds the top result to the schedule.

editor.title: Title
editor.new_subtitle: Slides are rebuilt as you type
editor.edit_subtitle: Changes apply to every schedule item that uses this song
editor.hint_blank: Blank line starts a new slide
editor.no_slides_body: Start writing lyrics on the left. Each blank line starts a new slide.
editor.save_failed: Could not save: {error}. Your lyrics are kept, try Save again.

bible.no_bibles_body: Bibles aren't bundled with the app because of their publishers' copyright. Use Manage Bibles to import a Zefania XML file you own.
bible.idle_body: Type a reference, then press Enter to add it to the schedule. Book names are Indonesian.
bible.split: split into slides of up to {count} characters
bible.long_note: Preview shows the first {shown} verses. All {total} verses are added to the schedule.
bible.unknown_book_body: Book names are Indonesian, for example Yoh 3:16 for Yohanes. Nothing was looked up.
bible.not_found_title: This verse is not in the selected translation
bible.not_found_body: {reference} isn't in {bible}. Check the verse number, or pick another translation from the list.
bible.lookup_failed: The passage could not be loaded

bible_manager.copyright_note: Bibles aren't bundled with the app because of their publishers' copyright. Import a Zefania XML file you own, UTF-8 encoded.
bible_manager.imported: {bible} imported: {verses}. Choose another file to add more.
bible_manager.imported_with_skipped: {bible} imported: {verses}, {skipped} skipped. Choose another file to add more.
bible_manager.subtitle: Translations available for verse lookups
bible_manager.reading: Reading verses from {file}… this can take a few seconds

theme.shadows_hint: Turn off if the app feels slow on this computer.

errors.empty_title: The song title must not be empty.

errors.bible_exists: A translation with the abbreviation "{abbreviation}" already exists in the library.
errors.empty_abbreviation: The translation abbreviation must not be empty.
errors.not_zefania: This file is not a Zefania XML Bible. Choose another file and import again.

reference.empty: Enter a verse reference, e.g. Yoh 3:16.
reference.missing_book: A reference must start with a book name, e.g. Yoh 3:16.
reference.ambiguous_book: "{input}" could mean {candidates}. Type more of the book name.
reference.invalid_number: Chapter and verse numbers start at 1.
reference.reversed_range: Reversed verse range: {start} is greater than {end}.

settings.invalid_color: Enter a complete six-digit hex color in Song and Scripture.
settings.invalid_values: Check the settings values before saving.
settings.empty_area: Safe margins and padding must leave room for content.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences for this computer
settings.saved_detail: Live keeps its current appearance until the next Go Live
settings.save_failed: Settings could not be saved: {error}. Your changes are kept; try again.
settings.startup: Open output when the app starts
settings.startup_hint: Uses the preferred monitor when it is available.
settings.advance: Advance the schedule preview after Go Live
settings.advance_hint: Moves to the next item after the selected item is live.
settings.no_monitors: No monitors detected. Refresh to try again.
settings.unavailable_hint: Reconnect this monitor or choose another one.
settings.safe_margins_hint: Reference pixels on a 1920-wide canvas, outside text padding.
settings.guides_hint: White: safe area · Blue: text padding
settings.overflow: Text may not fit. Reduce text size, padding or slide content.
settings.preview_note: Draft changes appear here. Apply or OK updates the operator preview.
settings.format_note: The canvas fits inside the output screen without stretching.
settings.font_missing: This font is unavailable. The preview and output use Inter.
settings.font_limit: Showing up to 6 families. Type to narrow the results.
settings.heading_hint: Projects the section label above the lyrics.
settings.copyright_hint: Repeats the song footer on every slide.
settings.license_hint: Appended to the copyright when the footer is visible.
settings.one_verse_hint: The character limit is ignored in this mode. Verses are never split.
settings.grouping_hint: Otherwise, complete verses are grouped by the character limit.
settings.labels_hint: Colors appear on operator labels only. Alt/Option + a letter cycles through matching song sections. Leave the shortcut blank to disable it.
settings.labels_limit: Up to 32 labels, 8 aliases each, and 64 characters per name or alias. Names, aliases and shortcuts must not conflict with another label.
settings.invalid_labels: Check song labels: names and aliases need 1–64 characters, at most 8 aliases, a six-digit hex color, and a blank or single uppercase A–Z shortcut.
settings.conflicting_labels: Two song labels share a name, alias or shortcut. Use distinct values before saving.
settings.fade_hint: Fade dims the outgoing text, then brings in the next text while blending the solid background.
settings.duration_hint: Fade duration: 100–2000 ms, in steps of 50. Cut keeps the remembered duration.
settings.invalid_transitions: Enter transition durations from 100 to 2000 ms in steps of 50.
